name: SaleSmartly – Live Chat & Chat Bot Integrate
author: salesmartly2021

sections.description:
SaleSmartly is a comprehensive communication platform built for cross-border businesses. It integrates major global channels—such as Livechat, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, TikTok, Instagram, Telegram, Line, Email, and VKontakte—into a single, unified dashboard. This allows businesses to efficiently manage customer interactions across multiple platforms and accounts, streamline sales, marketing, and support workflows, and enhance global communication through AI-powered automation and real-time translation in 134 languages.

Key Features

Activate Customers

  • Centralize all customer messages across platforms for efficient management
  • Bulk messaging to reach large audiences quickly
  • Real-time translation in 134 languages to break down communication barriers

Retain Customers

  • AI-powered intelligent routing for rapid responses and reduced customer churn
  • Automated follow-up workflows to maintain engagement and boost conversions
  • Smart scheduling and team collaboration tools to balance efficiency and service quality

Re-engage Customers

  • Automated customer tagging and profiling for personalized interactions
  • Real-time analytics and data visualization to monitor trends and inform strategic decisions

Tags

  • Intelligent customer service platform
  • One-stop chat management
  • Automated marketing assistant
  • Web chat plugin
  • Multi-channel social media support
